# swarmops show

Show one changeset.

```yaml
title: "swarmops show"
description: "Show one changeset."
group: "read"
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "show"
envelope_op: "show"
exit_codes: [0, 2, 6]
errors: [E_NOT_A_REPO, E_REV_NOT_FOUND, E_INVALID_ARG]
syntax: "swarmops show [OPTIONS] <REV>"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops show [OPTIONS] <REV>
```

## Required arguments

### `REV`

Syntax: `<REV>`.

The changeset.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--max-changes`

Syntax: `--max-changes <N>`.
Default: `400`.

The most changes to list.

## Examples

### CLI

```sh
swarmops --repo [tmp]/store show main
```

Exit code 0. Recorded by the CLI tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time.

## Return information

`result` is a `ChangesetDetail` (`swarmops schema ChangesetDetail` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | `Attribution` | yes | Who wrote the change. |
| `changes` | `array of ChangeOut` | yes | What changed relative to the first parent, ordered by path: at most `max_changes` entries. |
| `changes_truncated` | `boolean` | yes | Whether `changes` stops before the changeset's last change. |
| `created_at` | `integer` | yes | When it was recorded: the committer signature's time, in Unix milliseconds. |
| `files_changed` | `integer` | yes | How many paths the changeset changes in all, also when `changes` is truncated. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The changeset's id. |
| `land_key` | `string or null` | no | The idempotency key of the land that made it (its `land_key` metadata), when it had one. |
| `lander` | `Attribution or null` | no | Who landed it, for a changeset a `land` made: its `lander` and `lander_run_id` metadata. Omitted for any other changeset. |
| `message` | `string` | yes | The message. |
| `metadata` | `object` | yes | SwarmOps metadata, such as `agent` and `run_id`. A value that is not UTF-8 is given in standard, padded base64, under its key with `:b64` appended. A commit refuses a key that ends in `:b64`, so `k:b64` is always the base64 of `k`'s value, which is not UTF-8. |
| `parents` | `array of string` | yes | The parents' ids; the first is the mainline parent that `changes` are relative to. |
| `root` | `string` | yes | The root tree's id. |
| `seq` | `integer` | yes | Its position in the store's changeset index, in commit order. |
| `signatures` | `Signatures` | yes | The git author and committer signatures, kept for git fidelity. |
| `squashed_from` | `array of string` | no | The changesets a land squashed into it, oldest first: the landed head's first-parent chain after the land's base, ending at that head (its `squashed_from` metadata). Omitted for a changeset no land made. |

Envelope `op`: `show`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.
- `2`: The request or the command line is malformed.
- `6`: Something the request names does not exist.

## Errors

- [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo) (exit 6): No store at the given path, or no store was named.
- [`E_REV_NOT_FOUND`](../errors.md#e_rev_not_found) (exit 6): A revision names no changeset.
- [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2): A malformed argument or request, including a command-line usage error.

Any command that opens a store may also fail with a store error, such as [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo), [`E_IO`](../errors.md#e_io) or [`E_STORE_CORRUPT`](../errors.md#e_store_corrupt); a command line the grammar refuses is [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2).
